```plato

    // The distance to a lattice solid: the nearest capsule's distance. Exact —
    // a capsule distance is exact and the minimum of exact fields is the exact
    // distance to their union outside the solid.
    Eval(self: StrutSdf3D, point: Point3D): Number
        => self.Struts.Reduce(Number.MaxValue, (acc, s) =>
            acc.Min(DistanceToCapsule(point, s.A, s.B, self.Radius)));
```

## Line 599

**Source:** [stdlib/geometry/lattices.library.plato, line 599](../../../../../stdlib/geometry/lattices.library.plato#L599).

```plato

    // The distance to a graded lattice solid: the nearest capsule's distance,
    // each strut taking its own radius. Exact, as above.
    Eval(self: GradedStrutSdf3D, point: Point3D): Number
        => self.Struts.Count.MapRange(i =>
                DistanceToCapsule(point, self.Struts[i].A, self.Struts[i].B, self.Radii[i]))
            .Reduce(Number.MaxValue, (acc, d) => acc.Min(d));
```

```plato
    // The nodal implicit shifted so that its zero level set is the field's Level
    // isosurface. Not a distance — the solid types below carry the division that
    // makes one.
    Eval(self: TpmsField3D, point: Point3D): Number
        => TpmsNodalValue(self.Family, self.Period, point) - self.Level;
```

```plato
    // The signed distance to the network solid: negative in the labyrinth where
    // the implicit is at or below Level. A LOWER BOUND, not exact.
    Eval(self: TpmsNetwork3D, point: Point3D): Number
        => TpmsNormalizedValue(self.Family, self.Period, self.Level, point);
```

```plato
    // The signed distance to the sheet solid: negative within half of Thickness
    // of the Level isosurface, on either side of it. A LOWER BOUND, not exact.
    Eval(self: TpmsSheet3D, point: Point3D): Number
        => TpmsNormalizedValue(self.Family, self.Period, self.Level, point).Abs
         - self.Thickness * 0.5;
}
```
